note: The upstream artefacts the media pack repackages. scripts/media-pack.ps1 downloads each url and refuses it unless size and sha256 match; the files it extracts are checked against the sha256 in 'extract'. Nothing is built from source except holo-media.exe.

libmpv.note: zhongfly's LGPL x86_64 libmpv (mpv -Dgpl=false, ffmpeg without --enable-gpl or --enable-nonfree). Repackaged unmodified. sha256 is also the line in the release's sha256.txt, which the script cross-checks.

deno.note: yt-dlp's JavaScript runtime for YouTube. MIT. sha256 is the release's .sha256sum line.

ytdlp.note: yt-dlp is NOT in the pack. The 'media-ytdlp' lane (scripts/media-ytdlp.ps1) takes the newest release, checks SHA2-256SUMS against the maintainers' GPG signature with the key committed as media/yt-dlp-public.key, and publishes an unsigned hash manifest.

sources.note: Best-effort source mirror for the LGPL libmpv (media-pack.yml, melange-media-src-<version>.tar.gz). The commits are what zhongfly's release names (mpv, ffmpeg) or what its workflow checks out (the build scripts). The other libraries inside libmpv-2.dll (libass, freetype, harfbuzz, libplacebo, dav1d and others) are as published upstream by the build scripts; their commits are not pinned here.

archives.name: zhongfly-mpv-winbuild
archives.note: the newest commit of the default branch before the build; the release tag itself points at an empty marker commit

archives.name: shinchiro-mpv-winbuild-cmake
archives.note: the newest commit before the build; the workflow checks out the default branch
